recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in coordinated earth-toned and navy streetwear posing against a soft-focus nighttime city skyline, framed by bold, contrasting typographic styles at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal alignment of subjects across the mid-ground
Contrast between the sharp subjects and the bokeh city lights
Symmetry created by the top-heavy block text and bottom-heavy script text
Color coordination between clothing and background shadows
coreInvariants: Soft-focus urban background with circular bokeh
Warm skin tones against a cool night palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the central horizontal band, scaled to fill the width of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central two figures leaning toward each other, creating a focal point in the middle of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top block text, move down through the faces of the group, and settle on the decorative script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured sky at the top and deep shadows at the bottom provide breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm brown and tan (clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale orange and light blue (typography and bokeh lights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high-value highlights on the typography to ensure legibility against dark backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to muted earth tones and deep blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended geometric sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: ultra-wide, low-waisted, geometric construction with a horizontal underline
Bottom text: diagonal baseline, high-contrast script with fluid swashes and drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'w' in top text uses a single continuous stroke
Script 'A' and 'F' feature exaggerated descenders and loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, horizontal geometry and fluid, diagonal organic forms.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule underlining the top display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric feel of the top display text
Captures the casual, hand-drawn energy of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four men in 1980s streetwear (oversized shirts, earth tones) standing in a row at night. The background is a dark city skyline with soft, out-of-focus bokeh lights in yellow and green. Low-angle shot, cinematic lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply an ultra-extended lowercase sans-serif font at the top with a horizontal underline. Apply a diagonal, light blue brush script with a white outline and drop shadow at the bottom right, partially overlapping the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the top text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the bottom text tilted on a diagonal axis?
Are the subjects wearing muted, coordinated colors?
Is the background bokeh circular and soft?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
Specific color of the script text
Width of the top text extension
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on hats or clothing
Exact facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between top and bottom text
Legibility of text against busy background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the underline does not cut through the letters
Ensure the script text has a visible drop shadow for depth
Verify the color palette remains in the earth-tone and navy range
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group Portrait + Extended Geometric Header + Diagonal Brush Script Footer + Bokeh Night Cityscape
